statement: Whenever prune_tree root returns Ok r, then for every finite path p (a sequence of L and R steps from the root, with the empty path denoting the root), r has a node at path p if and only if root has a node at path p and the subtree of root rooted at that node contains at least one node with value 1. Moreover, for every such path p, the value of the node of r at p equals the value of the node of root at p. (A tree has a node at path p only when all prefixes of p exist; the subtree rooted at a node is that node together with all its descendants.)
preconditions: root is a finite binary tree (Null or Node(v,l,r)) with every node value equal to 0 or 1, and the number of nodes in root is between 1 and 200 inclusive.

statement: prune_tree root returns Ok r for some tree r; in particular it does not fail by panic, overflow, or out-of-bounds access.
preconditions: root is a finite binary tree with every node value equal to 0 or 1, and the number of nodes in root is between 1 and 200 inclusive.

statement: Whenever prune_tree root returns Ok r, the tree r contains a node with value 1 if and only if root contains a node with value 1. (A tree contains a 1 when some node in it has value 1.)
preconditions: root is a finite binary tree with every node value equal to 0 or 1, and the number of nodes in root is between 1 and 200 inclusive.

statement: Whenever prune_tree root returns Ok r, for every node x of r, the subtree of r rooted at x contains at least one node with value 1. If r = Null this condition is vacuous. (The subtree rooted at x is x together with all descendants of x.)
preconditions: root is a finite binary tree with every node value equal to 0 or 1, and the number of nodes in root is between 1 and 200 inclusive.

statement: Whenever prune_tree root returns Ok r, for every finite path p (a sequence of L and R steps from the root, empty path = root), if root has a node at path p with value 1, then r has a node at path p with value 1.
preconditions: root is a finite binary tree with every node value equal to 0 or 1, and the number of nodes in root is between 1 and 200 inclusive.

statement: Whenever prune_tree root returns Ok r, for every finite path p, if r has a node at path p, then root has a node at path p and the value of the node of r at p equals the value of the node of root at p.
preconditions: root is a finite binary tree with every node value equal to 0 or 1, and the number of nodes in root is between 1 and 200 inclusive.

statement: Whenever prune_tree root returns Ok r, for every finite path p, if root has a node at path p and the subtree of root rooted at that node contains at least one node with value 1, then r has a node at path p with the same value.
preconditions: root is a finite binary tree with every node value equal to 0 or 1, and the number of nodes in root is between 1 and 200 inclusive.

statement: Whenever prune_tree root returns Ok r, for every finite path p, if root has a node at path p and the subtree of root rooted at that node contains no node with value 1, then r has no node at path p.
preconditions: root is a finite binary tree with every node value equal to 0 or 1, and the number of nodes in root is between 1 and 200 inclusive.

statement: Whenever prune_tree root returns Ok r, the number of nodes in r equals the number of nodes x of root such that the subtree of root rooted at x contains at least one node with value 1.
preconditions: root is a finite binary tree with every node value equal to 0 or 1, and the number of nodes in root is between 1 and 200 inclusive.

statement: Whenever prune_tree root returns Ok r, for every node x of r, if x has value 0 then x has at least one non-null child in r. Equivalently, every leaf of r has value 1 (unless r = Null).
preconditions: root is a finite binary tree with every node value equal to 0 or 1, and the number of nodes in root is between 1 and 200 inclusive.

statement: Whenever prune_tree root returns Ok r and prune_tree r returns Ok r', then r' = r.
preconditions: root is a finite binary tree with every node value equal to 0 or 1, and the number of nodes in root is between 1 and 200 inclusive.
